subject: maths
question: The simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,200 at the rate of 7% per annum in 2 years is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,200

Rate of Interest (R) = 7% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (2200 × 7 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = (2200 × 14) / 100

⇒ SI = 308

**The simple interest (in ₹) is ₹308.**
